text: At the June 26 to 229, 2018 City Council meeting Council approved dozens of Community Safety Zones around schools to help create a safer walk to school. I asked residents of Ward 30 about their routes to school and added several new Community Safety Zones based on what I heard. I have recently heard that residents and active transportation advocates would like to add Dundas between Pape and Greenwood as a Community Safety Zone. This stretch of Dundas is heavily used by students going to Leslieville Public School and is a busy arterial road where safety is always a concern. Adding this as a Community Safety Zone will make it easier to implement traffic calming and pedestrian protection measures. REQUIRES RE-OPENING: Item PW30.5 - City Council June 26, 27, 28 and 29, 2017 to add a community safety zone.
City Council on July 23, 24, 25, 26, 27 and 30, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council add Dundas Street East between Pape Avenue and Greenwood Avenue as a Community Safety Zone.
